The Appalling Idiots Who Govern Us
From Politically Incorrect August 23, 1999

"If you do wave a drug war like they've done in Europe and some of the Scandinavian countries, you go down and you can buy heroin at the convenience store. You can buy marijuana. I just don't think that's the direction that we want to move in our society. And even if you say, "We're gonna solve some problems," it still doesn't do away with the harm that it does to teenagers and young people."

Maher introduced Hutchinson as "one of our distinguished house managers who prosecuted the impeachment of Bill Clinton."

I think Maher was being sarcastic. It is easy to see why they couldn’t convict Clinton. They probably had him confused with a country in Europe, or somewhere.

For the record, there are no countries in Europe – or anywhere else in the world -- where "you go down and you can buy heroin at the convenience store." Well, perhaps in some neighborhoods in Washington, D.C...

The countries of Scandinavia, a part of Europe, by the way, Norway, Denmark and Sweden, vary greatly in their drugs policies. Denmark is the most liberal. No "drugs" are "legal" there, but there is a section of Copenhagen where cannabis is sold with impunity. Sweden is the most prohibitionist, and they have more of a substance abuse problem than most countries.

See
Analysis By Dutch Center Shows
"Claims Regarding Effectiveness Of The Swedish Drug Policy Cannot Be Proven."

In Holland, marijuana is sold in coffee shops, which are very convenient, and the Dutch have a lower rate of marijuana and hard drug use than does DEAland.

See
Legalize Marijuana and Reduce Use?
New Survey Puts Estimate of Dutch Marijuana Use Even More Below DEAland

Switzerland is going its own way, as usual.
See
"I just returned from a few days in Switzerland,
and I have seen the best-case future for cannabis."
By Richard Rose – Special To MarijuanaNews

Meanwhile back in Arkansas, the teaching of geography appears not to have reached some segments of the population. I really cannot understand why people like Hutchinson would go on Maher’s program and make complete fools of themselves when they could do that at home with their own constituents, who seem to find it charming.
